scope: read archived opportunities, outcomes, accounts; never replay strategies, optimize thresholds, generate seven strategies, or fit AI
timestamps: separate registration and eligible-entry snapshots; use last closed candle ending at floor(cutoff/frame)*frame; missing expected close is unknown, never forward-fill; current entry candle excluded
trend: unchanged P1-03 MA200 and 20-bar slope; transition_or_range is not proof of consolidation
efficiency_ratio: ER20=abs(C[p]-C[p-20])/sum(abs(C[j]-C[j-1]),j=p-19..p); flat denominator yields0; <=0.2 range_proxy, >=0.4 efficient_move_proxy, else mixed; contiguous21 bars required
volatility_level: unchanged P1-03 ATR14/close percentile in current and199 previous valid ATR values, <=.25 low, >=.75 high
volatility_change: ATR14[p]/ATR14[p-20], >1 expansion, <1 contraction, ==1 unchanged; both ATRs in same contiguous segment
break_context: on each own timeframe: prior20 bar high/low excludes current closed bar; strict current breach and close beyond is confirmed_break; breach and strict close back inside is sweep_reclaim; both edges, equal close, no breach kept separately; describes only known close, not eventual breakout success
rvol: unchanged P1-04 closed volume / previous20 volumes, <.8 low, >=1.2 high, else normal; explicit unavailable statuses
liquidity_proxies: close*base_volume approximate USDT turnover, midrank against strictly previous200 contiguous bars <=.25 low >=.75 high; abs(log(C[p]/C[p-1]))/(C[p]*V[p]) OHLCV illiquidity proxy; zero denominator unknown; no spread/depth/CVD/absorption or fill claims
quality: raw OHLCV validation plus SHA24 files; record zero-volume windows; no gap interpolation; frozen source status is an outcome, never a feature
grouping: all160 archived account profiles kept separate; all periods/scenarios/models; BTC/other7/each coin/year/UTC00-08,08-16,16-24; every fixed categorical bucket including zero samples; no scenario/period/profile pooling
isolated_events: read archived outcomes only, long isolated A/S and two20D arms as primary diagnostic population; include all known executed-proxy outcomes, retain future quality flags, no hindsight admission filter
costs: decompose gross_R-fees_R-slippage_R=net_R at actual archived risk; preentry expected normal-stop cost share uses actual scenario slippage and known entry/stop; bins<=.25 vs>.25 frozen old definition; stop/ATR bins<.5,.5-1,1-2,>=2; never change SL/TP/RR
inference: global calendar28-day blocks anchored2020-10-15,1000 resamples seed808, same time block across coins; percentile95 intervals of ratio sumR/count and paired differences; zero-event blocks retained; conditional exploratory intervals, not iid significance or newOOS

contrasts.question: is closed preentry price efficiency associated with higher netR and lower stop rate?
do narrow economic margins explain net failure despite similar raw-price R?

hypothesis_prioritization: at most2 for P1-08B; require both arms>=30 in Train and Validation, positive mean-net-R difference both periods, pooled95 block interval lower>0, no sign reversal in BTC/other7 or openedTest with>=30 each; retain absence of adequate samples as inconclusive, never force candidates; no positive-strategy claim
future_study: fresh data strictly after next protocol freeze, at least24 months and20 nonempty28-day blocks,>=200 eligible opportunities per arm,>=30 profitable and30 losing per arm,>=30 BTC per arm; sample floors are operational not a power guarantee; fixed calendar review not optional stopping
structures: specification and feasibility only: harmonic/Fibonacci, Elliott/ABCDE,2B,OB,FVG,sweep,candle-volume; distinguish confirmed, awaiting, retrospective; no new detectors or trading strategies
